ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, filled buttons, dark surface backgrounds, heading strokes — a warm-tinted near-black that replaces pure #000 throughout the system

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, light section backgrounds, button borders on dark surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary body text, helper text, muted borders, low-emphasis UI metadata

nyght-serif.$description: Reserved exclusively for display and heading levels (26-72px). Weight 300 is the signature: most systems reach for 600-700 serif, this whisper-weight creates editorial gravitas through restraint. Letter-spacing widens slightly at smaller sizes (0.03em) and tightens at display sizes (0.01em) to preserve optical balance.

switzer.$description: Workhorse for nav, body, buttons, labels, card metadata, and small headings. Tracking runs consistently at 0.03em — a subtle positive letter-spacing that gives the grotesque a calm, considered cadence. Weight 500 for emphasis, 600 for button text and nav active states.
